questions.text:
7. [Maximum mark: 6]
Runners in an athletics club have season’s best times for the 100 m , which can be modelled
by a normal distribution with mean 11.6 seconds and standard deviation 0.8 seconds.
To qualify for a particular competition a runner must have a season’s best time of under
11 seconds. A runner from this club who has qualified for the competition is selected at
random. Find the probability that he has a season’s best time of under 10.7 seconds.

Find the probability that he has a season's best time of under $10.7$ seconds.
